title: Video Factory Manifest
description: Declarative, human-reviewable source of truth for one video. The Director/Screenwriter agents SERIALIZE their creative work into this; it is reviewed by a human BEFORE any expensive generation call; then the Producer/Editor agents consume and UPDATE it in place as assets are produced. If output is wrong, fix the manifest, not the code.

intent.description: One sentence: who this is for and what it must achieve. Anchors every downstream judgment call.

format.description: Output aspect ratios to render. Each becomes its own MP4.

compositor.description: Compositor engine to render the manifest.

brand.description: Visual + sonic identity carried across every scene. Locks consistency (drift is the #1 slop signal).

lut.description: Path to a .cube LUT applied to all generated clips before scene-specific correction.

music_style.description: Default music brief if a scene omits its own.

tone.description: e.g. 'calm authoritative', 'high-energy'. Drives TTS delivery + pacing.

ref_lock.description: Default ref_lock behavior across all scenes.

style_suffix.description: Look lock: one sentence of lens / light / texture / colour words appended VERBATIM to every image and clip brief, so every generated plate comes from the same style family. Write it once; never vary it per scene.

look_ref.description: Look lock: path to ONE reference frame. Passed to image/clip adapters as a colour-and-texture reference only (never as content).

palette_min_score.description: Minimum palette score (0-100, scripts/palette-score.mjs) a generated still must reach. Below it the still is remade at the source, not graded.

hook.description: The first 0-3s. 50-60% of drop-off happens here. MUST work muted (60%+ watch silent).

text.description: On-screen text that lands before the voiceover. Never a logo.

through_line.description: The ONE device every scene carries, drawn in the same corner of every frame, that changes state as the story moves (a counter, a clock, a progress bar, a tag). It is what makes separate scenes read as one piece. Required unless rules.through_line is false.

label.description: Small caption above the value, e.g. 'viewers still watching'.

states.description: In scene order, starting at the first scene. Each state must move the value on.

scene.description: Scene id where this state begins.

rules.description: Overrides for the audit (scripts/validate-manifest.mjs). Every override is a written-down choice.

budget.description: Spend control, enforced by the producer (not by the agent's good intentions).

cap_usd.description: The producer refuses any paid call that would take recorded spend past this.

frozen.description: Stop switch: true = no paid call runs. Set it the moment quality is in doubt; fix the plan, then unfreeze.

approval.description: Written by scripts/approve.mjs after a person approves the storyboard. Stored against a hash of the creative content: any later edit makes it stale and the producer stops before spending.

grid.description: Produced by scripts/snap-grid.mjs: the beat map of the music bed that every cut sits on.

id.description: Stable unique id, e.g. 's1'. Asset filenames key off this.

tts_script.description: EXACT narration. Source of truth for TIMING — scene duration is derived from real audio length, never estimated. Also the on-screen text and caption source. When `voiceover` is set, keep tts_script verbatim-equal to the spoken clip so captions and on-screen copy match.

tts_phonetic.description: Optional phonetic pronunciation string sent to the TTS voice engine. Enables ear vs eye decoupling: technical syntax stays in tts_script for on-screen typography/captions, while tts_phonetic ensures correct pronunciation (e.g. 'claud-dot-m-d').

voiceover.description: Path to a SUPPLIED real-voice audio clip to use as this scene's narration instead of TTS — e.g. a speaker's actual voice pulled from a recording via `scripts/extract-voice.mjs`. The producer uses it as the scene audio, measures its real duration, and recovers caption word-timings via STT. Use for apex quotes where authentic delivery beats TTS.

duration_estimate_s.description: Planning estimate only; replaced by measured audio duration after TTS.

duration_ms.description: Measured scene duration in milliseconds from real audio/media.

_audio.description: Path to generated/extracted scene narration audio.

_sfx.description: Paths to generated scene sound effects.

source.description: code = Remotion-animated (zero-key); image = generated still; clip = generative video; screen_rec = supplied recording; avatar = talking head.

visual_brief.description: SEMANTIC art direction, NOT a keyword. 'neurons firing across a dark synaptic gap', not 'brain'. The Editor scores the produced asset against this before committing it.

asset.description: Path to the produced/supplied asset (filled by the pipeline).

_generated.description: Produced: true when the pipeline generated `asset` (a supplied asset is a creative choice and is part of the approval hash; a generated one is not).

ref_lock.description: Whether to lock generative video with an image still frame.

fit.description: For source=image: object-fit. 'cover' crops to fill (default for photos); 'contain' shows the whole asset on the brand background (use for portrait/poster art like a magazine cover so nothing is cropped).

objectPosition.description: For source=image: CSS object-position (e.g. '68% 42%'). Biases the Ken-Burns crop so an off-centre subject survives a tighter aspect (e.g. keep a right-of-centre speaker in the 9:16 cut).

props.description: For source=code: props passed to the component.

shot.description: Encourages shot variety (>=3 types / 60s). Advisory to the generator.

continuity_refs.description: Frame/asset paths from prior scenes to seed this scene's generation — carries character/look forward.

captions.description: auto = word-level animated captions from real STT timestamps.

music_bed.description: Music brief for this scene, or 'continue' to hold the prior track. Chapter changes should change the track.

sfx.description: SFX briefs, e.g. 'soft whoosh on cut', 'impact hit on reveal'.

provider_assignments.description: Per-scene provider overrides. Omitted = skill defaults (providers/providers.json).

graphics.description: Explaining graphics drawn in code over the scene. Every narrated sentence needs one (or the scene sets `stillness`). Each enters ON the spoken word that names it and stays to the end of the scene, so a shot builds instead of holding still. Vary the kind: never the same one three times running.

kind.description: number → counter / bar / gauge / tally · claim or category → stamp / tag · place or thing → label · tech or speech → terminal / chat · correction → strike · process → checklist / timeline

anchor.description: A word or short phrase from this scene's tts_script. The graphic enters when it is spoken.

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of the anchor, when it is said more than once.

slot.description: Where it sits. Omit to auto-place. The bottom band belongs to the captions.

title.description: Small mono heading on the panel.

panel.description: false = draw without the panel background.

hold_ms.description: Remove after this long. Omit to hold to the end of the scene.

props.description: Per kind — counter {from,to,prefix,suffix,decimals,label} · bar {items:[{label,value}],unit,max} · gauge {value,max,display,label} · tally {count,lit,label} · stamp {text,rotate} · tag {class,text,sub} · label {text,sub,source} · terminal {lines[],prompt,cps} · chat {messages:[{from,text}]} · strike {text,replace} · checklist {items[]} · timeline {points:[{label,value}]}

stillness.description: The written reason this scene deliberately carries no explaining graphic (e.g. 'the quote holds alone'). Exempts it from the graphic-per-sentence gate.

run.description: true = part of a declared fast run (3-4 simple images on the beat); exempts the shot from the 1-second minimum.

audio_ms.description: Measured narration length, kept when snap-grid lengthens duration_ms so the cut lands on a beat.

_look.description: Produced: look check of the generated still (scripts/palette-score.mjs).

quality_gate.description: Hard gates checked before a scene is accepted. Failure triggers regeneration, not silent continuation.

min_semantic_score.description: Editor's score (0-1) of the asset vs visual_brief.

silence_max_ms.description: Max leading/trailing silence in the TTS audio (ffprobe).
